summary_1line: Bhishma and Parashurama’s cosmic weapon clash is halted by gods and sages, leading both to desist and reconcile with mutual respect.

image_candidates.scene_text: Two blazing celestial weapons collide in mid-air, setting the sky aflame while gods, sages, and creatures tremble below.
Narada and radiant sages appear in the sky, raising their hands to command Bhishma to withdraw the terrible Praswapa weapon.
Wounded yet resolute, Bhishma approaches Parashurama on the battlefield and bows to his teacher as the ascetic smiles in approval.
